title: Sehmoune N Probable NDE 6966
content: Before this happened I was so intelligent. I was only 13, nevertheless I had the culture of an adult. One day I started to have backaches, I was told that it was a scoliosis. I started to wear a corset. About nine months later, there came the need to operate on me. One month after the operation, I started to feel bad. I couldn't sleep nor eat anymore. The nurse examined me and said, ‘You have to be operated on, as the staphylococcus aureus [Editor’s note: An infection.] has increased. You could die if we do not react’. So the following day I was operated to clear the problem. Just after the operation, I saw my open back. I had lost three liters of blood. At that moment I was dead, I saw a white path with my cousin and a light at the end. I talked to him. Another path was black with much blood and screaming. I saw an old woman there that I knew. Before seeing all this a spirit asked me ‘do you believe in God?’ and I said ‘yes’. Then at the end, my cousin told me to go back to my mother to take care of her. I came back to life but fell into a coma for one month and a semi-coma for two more months. When I woke up after the comas, I wasn't the same person. I had forgotten everything and couldn't control myself anymore. On the 2nd of January of this year, I woke up and was cured. I don't remember what happened during my three years’ stay at the hospital, but I was told that I did horrible things and that all my relatives suffered because of this. Now I'm cured but I don't have the same school levels as I had before.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Just after the operation, the experiencer reports: 'I saw my open back.'

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A 'white path' with a light at the end; also a separate 'black' path with much blood and screaming.

arrival.other_being_detail: A 'spirit' asked, 'do you believe in God?' An 'old woman' was seen on the black path and was known by the experiencer.

environment.environment_other_detail: Two paths: a white path with a light at the end; another black path with much blood and screaming.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: The cousin told the experiencer to 'go back to my mother to take care of her.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Post-surgical complication/infection (staphylococcus aureus) requiring re-operation; reported loss of three liters of blood and 'At that moment I was dead.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Two divergent paths (white vs black) with contrasting emotional content; question from a 'spirit' about belief in God.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Reported sequence: saw open back/was dead → saw paths and light, with cousin present → a spirit asked about belief in God → cousin instructed return to care for mother → return to life with prolonged coma.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Two distinct paths were perceived: a white path with a light and the cousin; and a black path with much blood and screaming, where an old woman known to the experiencer was seen.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “At that moment I was dead, I saw a white path with my cousin and a light at the end.” / “Another path was black with much blood and screaming.” / “do you believe in God?” / “go back to my mother to take care of her.”
